FINAL CHECKS · ITEM 02 / 05

Check curve versus movement檢查移線或沿線

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Check whether a question asks for a change in a curve or a movement along it, and whether other determinants are held constant.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

先找市場及變動因素；自身價格改變沿線，其他決定因素改變可移線。題目指定其他不變的條件要保留。

Identify the market and the changed determinant. Own price changes quantity along a curve; another determinant can move the entire curve. Keep all stated “other things equal” assumptions in place.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A rise in coffee price moves along coffee demand but can shift tea demand. 同一事件對不同市場的曲線影響不同。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

A good's production cost falls. Which curve shifts in its market? 生產成本下降？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
